title: Side plank from knees

steps.text: Lie on one side with your forearm on the floor under your shoulder and your knees bent.
steps.cue: On your side, forearm under your shoulder, knees bent.

steps.text: Stack your hips and shoulders and press your forearm down.
steps.cue: Stack hips and shoulders. Press the forearm down.

steps.text: Lift your hips until your body makes a straight line from head to knees.
steps.cue: Lift your hips into one straight line.

steps.text: Hold for 3 slow breaths, then lower.
steps.cue: Hold for three slow breaths, then lower.

mistakes: Letting your hips sink toward the floor.
regression: Hold for one breath, or stay on your side and only press the forearm down.
stopIf: Stop if you feel pain in your shoulder, wrist or hip.

anatomy.why: The side of the waist holds the hips up so the body stays in one line.
